# ApplyPointwiseFunction

Qualified name: `manim.animation.transform.ApplyPointwiseFunction`

class ApplyPointwiseFunction(*mobject=None*, *\*args*, *use\_override=True*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`ApplyMethod`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.transform.ApplyMethod.html#manim.animation.transform.ApplyMethod "manim.animation.transform.ApplyMethod")

    Animation that applies a pointwise function to a mobject.

    Examples

    Example: WarpSquare

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/WarpSquare-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class WarpSquare(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            square = Square()
            self.play(
                ApplyPointwiseFunction(
                    lambda point: complex_to_R3(np.exp(R3_to_complex(point))), square
                )
            )
            self.wait()
    ```
